diff --git a/work.py b/work.py
index 90aaa01..23186eb 100644
--- a/work.py
+++ b/work.py
@@ -1 +1,67 @@
-# Complete the required API and report.
+"""Layered configuration evaluation."""
+
+import re
+
+_INTEGER = re.compile(r"-?[0-9]+\Z")
+
+
+def _failure(error):
+    return {"ok": False, "config": {}, "error": error}
+
+
+def evaluate(request, policy):
+    """Apply a request's configuration layers under the supplied policy."""
+    defaults = policy["defaults"]
+    types = policy["types"]
+    config = dict(defaults)
+    known = set(defaults)
+
+    for layer in request.get("layers", []):
+        for key, value in layer.items():
+            if key not in known:
+                return _failure("unknown_key")
+            if value is None and policy.get("null_resets") is True:
+                config[key] = defaults[key]
+            else:
+                config[key] = value
+
+    environment = request.get("environment", request.get("env", {}))
+    if environment:
+        if policy.get("environment") is not True:
+            return _failure("environment")
+        for key, value in environment.items():
+            if key not in known:
+                return _failure("unknown_key")
+            expected = types.get(key)
+            if expected == "boolean":
+                if value == "true":
+                    config[key] = True
+                elif value == "false":
+                    config[key] = False
+                else:
+                    return _failure("environment")
+            elif expected == "integer":
+                if not isinstance(value, str) or _INTEGER.fullmatch(value) is None:
+                    return _failure("environment")
+                config[key] = int(value)
+            elif expected == "string":
+                if not isinstance(value, str):
+                    return _failure("environment")
+                config[key] = value
+            else:
+                return _failure("environment")
+
+    for key, expected in types.items():
+        value = config.get(key)
+        if expected == "boolean":
+            valid = type(value) is bool
+        elif expected == "integer":
+            valid = type(value) is int
+        elif expected == "string":
+            valid = type(value) is str
+        else:
+            valid = False
+        if not valid:
+            return _failure("type")
+
+    return {"ok": True, "config": config, "error": None}
